name: fabricator-videos
description: Videos hosted by Ray: the docs site's intro and the Learn Rayfin with Ray lessons. Rendered with Remotion; voice, music and sound effects from ElevenLabs.

scripts.studio: npm run assets && remotion studio src/index.ts
scripts.render: npm run assets && remotion render src/index.ts FabricatorIntro out/fabricator-intro.mp4 && remotion render src/index.ts FabricatorIntroLight out/fabricator-intro.light.mp4 && node tools/master.mjs out/fabricator-intro.mp4 out/fabricator-intro.light.mp4
scripts.render:dark: npm run assets && remotion render src/index.ts FabricatorIntro out/fabricator-intro.mp4 && node tools/master.mjs out/fabricator-intro.mp4
scripts.render:light: npm run assets && remotion render src/index.ts FabricatorIntroLight out/fabricator-intro.light.mp4 && node tools/master.mjs out/fabricator-intro.light.mp4
